status: prospective; evaluation retrieval has not run

sampling.retain: Every response, returned rank, duplicate, refusal, timeout, malformed response and empty result. Do not replace exclusions or failures with extra queries.
sampling.annotation_unit: Every unique returned theorem_id and its entire generated slogan, preserving all query/rank occurrences. Atomize only when needed without dropping inconvenient clauses.
sampling.development_policy: Retain occurrences in the retrieval record but exclude this previously inspected normalization example from the prospective evaluation denominator.
sampling.population_limit: Fixed purposive probe, not a random sample of the service or mathematics. No population error-rate inference.

annotation.reviewers: Two independent agent source reviewers, with identity and model recorded; correlated model errors remain possible. No human-study claim.
annotation.round_one: Judge source support without the new automated checker. Preserve each reviewer's original labels and source locators before adjudication.
annotation.round_two: Apply machine checking only after a reviewer explicitly maps the claim to supported typed quantities and assumptions. Retain the annotation and report changes separately.

labels.supported: The statement and material conventions are supported by the original source in their recorded context.
labels.refuted: The original source or an exact separating witness contradicts an unambiguous reading.
labels.insufficient: Missing or ambiguous convention, partial support, or narrower evidence without a decisive contradiction.
labels.abstain: Source inaccessible or claim cannot be interpreted without inventing an assumption or changing its meaning.

annotation.limits: No automatic natural-language accuracy, researcher-time benefit, or global novelty claim. A finite successful example does not prove a theorem.
